conversations.title: Stay here or use the browser

messages.content: I keep bouncing between ChatGPT in the browser and this. When should I stay here?
What should a personal LLM harness optimize for if it is not engagement?

Control and legibility.

- Keep data on disk you can leave with.
- Show how context was assembled for each reply.
- Prefer tools you can inspect over a persona you cannot.

Voice-first capture helps when the keyboard is the wrong interface; the transcript should stay yours.
How does context get assembled for a reply?
Memories, temporal notes, and the system prompt — then the visible thread.
How do I pair the phone?
On Mac: System → Show Sync QR. On iOS: Set up sync. Credentials stay short-lived.
Add buy groceries and call the dentist.

notes.title: Week of September 14
notes.content:
# Week of September 14

The theme this week is fewer, longer blocks. Mornings stay for writing; meetings move after lunch.

## Decisions

- Ship the notes merge before touching the sidebar again.
- Keep Grill mode to one question at a time. Lists of five questions read like a form.
- Dictation stays the default on the phone. Typing is the fallback, not the other way round.

## Open questions

- Does memory need an expiry, or is a weekly review enough?
- Where should long replies land when there is no note open?

## Reading

- *The Mythical Man-Month*, chapter 2
- Notes from Tuesday's walk, transcribed and cleaned up
